name: Eager to Please
body:
Your whole life, you have worked hard to earn the approval of others.

Benefit: If you are using the rules for young characters, you are not restricted to taking levels in NPC classes before becoming an adult. In addition, once per week as a free action, you may reroll a failed either a Bluff or Diplomacy check. Apply the highest roll against any one creature of your choice. The original result stands for any other creatures. One of these skills is a class skill for you; this class skill must be chosen when you take this trait.
